question: How do Brahmā and Viṣṇu seek to worship the all-auspicious gift?
premises: Brahmā and Viṣṇu wish to worship
The object of worship bestows auspiciousness
They ask about the proper method
inference: Brahmā and Viṣṇu ask how they should worship that all-auspicious gift.
plain_english: How shall we two worship that, which bestows all auspiciousness?
